==Acquisition==
'''[[Skill quest]]s'''
*[[Plan A]] ([[Grothmar Wardowns]])

== Notes ==
* When used with a [[scythe]], this skill inflicts blindness to all foes struck by the attack. 
{{Anomaly |When sorting skills by type in the [[Skills and Attributes Panel]], this skill is under its own "Melee Attack" category, while all the other melee attacks are in a separate "Melee Attack" category.}}

==Trivia==
* This skill is the only melee attack that qualifies as a lead attack but doesn't require [[daggers]].
*This skill is a likely reference to the [[Wikipedia:Rogue (Dungeons & Dragons)|Dungeons & Dragons]] signature class feature of the [http://www.dandwiki.com/wiki/Rogue_%28SRD_Class%29 Rogue].
